title: Indigenous Peoples, Colonization and Anthropology
description: Provides a foundational understanding of the relationship between Indigenous Peoples and anthropology. Explores the history of colonization in Canada from an Indigenous and anthropological perspective. Examines the relationship between Indigenous Peoples and the anthropological subfields of sociocultural anthropology, archaeology, biological anthropology, linguistics and visual anthropology. Considers the historical, anthropological and ethnographic literature and how to acknowledge and move beyond the critiques.
